scope: Actual CPU API/gateway + loopback GPU, one approved full hand

metadata.prompt: Apply restrained everyday makeup with light upper-lash definition, soft neutral cheek blush and a muted rose lip. Edit the supplied photo of the same person. Keep their recognizable identity, face shape, eyes, nose, mouth geometry, expression, natural skin tone and skin texture. Keep the original hairstyle, hair color, clothing, background, pose, framing and lighting. Change makeup only. Keep cosmetic color in plausible facial regions and avoid mask-like patches or plastic skin.

limits: Deterministic built-in recommendation provider for reproducible generation; no Gemini conversation test
One paired observation per application case; no universal speed claim
In-process ASGI gateway and real loopback HTTP worker, no Next.js/browser/network/device acceptance
Mask observer copies are included equally in measured requests; no segmentation reuse optimization
Baseline runs first; first-request warm-up/order effects may affect single-pair timings
Consultation first/all timings include local result checks between sequential calls, not browser-visible completion
